Questions

What is Trainee?

A career agent that lives in your messages. Text it what you want and it finds jobs, tailors your resume, applies, sets up coffee chats and preps you for interviews.

Does it apply without asking me?

No. Trainee shows you each batch and waits for your yes, unless you set rules for it.

Do I need to download an app?

No. Join the waitlist below. When your spot opens, Trainee texts you and lives in your Messages app from then on.

When does Trainee launch?

[Launch timing]. Join the waitlist and we'll text you as soon as your spot opens.

How much does it cost?

[YOUR PRICE]. Cancel anytime.
